explanation: Matches the n = 2 case of Problem 7.2 of Kolountzakis–Lev–Matolcsi (arXiv 2209.04540), which says the problem is proved for n = 2 by [GL20]. Section 1 describes [GL20] as treating a convex polygon factor, and Theorem 1.6 of the same paper shows a convex body factor of a spectral product must be a polytope, so together they cover a general convex body. Faithful.
